note: Written before any forward pass of this item. Later stages read these values; they are not changed.

differentiation_series.why: Erythroid branch of haematopoiesis: hematopoietic stem cell -> common myeloid progenitor (upstream of the megakaryocyte-erythroid progenitor) -> erythroid progenitor cell -> erythrocyte. All four labels exist in bone marrow 10x 3' v3 cells of several donors. Stage numbers are ordinal labels from the cell-type annotation, not measured time. 'hematopoietic precursor cell' is left out because its free annotations mix granulocyte, monocyte and other cells. Smart-seq2 cells are left out (read counts; MaxToki-217M handles them badly, checks/V3_INPUTS_REPORT.md). 10x 5' v2 cells are left out so that one assay covers every stage.

cells.selection: donors ['TSP14', 'TSP21', 'TSP25']; up to 30 random cells per (stage, donor); used for the signatures, the axis and the feature choice
cells.steered: 50 random HSCs from donors ['TSP2', 'TSP27'] (donor-disjoint from selection)
cells.axis_validation: 30 random CMP and 30 random EryP cells from donors ['TSP2', 'TSP27'], plus the 50 steered HSCs (clean passes only)
cells.sampling: numpy default_rng(20261003); groups drawn in a fixed order; row indices sorted

input_encoding: raw/X integer counts -> counts / total * 1e4 / Geneformer gene median, ranked, first 2046 genes, <bos>/<eos> (inputs_v3.tokenize_counts); assert_encoding_batch on every cell right before its forward passes

readout.m: logits averaged over all positions of the sequence (as deployed)
readout.signatures: g_early = mean m of selection HSCs; g_late = mean m of selection erythrocytes (also g_cmp, g_eryp, g_all for re-scoring)
readout.delta_s: s(m_steered) - s(m_clean) for the same cell (clean = same computation path, no edit)
readout.gap_share: (m_steered - m_clean) . (g_late - g_early) / |g_late - g_early|^2 (share of the early-to-late distance moved along that line)
readout.natural_span: S = mean s over selection erythrocytes - mean s over selection HSCs; delta_s is also given as a percentage of S

axis_check: on steering-donor cells (never used to build g): AUROC of s for EryP vs HSC >= 0.8 and Spearman(s, stage) > 0 over HSC/CMP/EryP; steering is not run if it fails

features.per_cell_activation: a_f(cell) = mean over gene positions (not <bos>/<eos>) of the v3 SAE code z_f
features.alive: z_f > 0 at >= 1 gene position in >= 50% of selection HSC cells
features.maturity_correlation: rho_f = mean over the 3 selection donors of the within-donor Spearman correlation between a_f and the stage number (0-3); constant -> 0
features.candidates: the 3 alive features with the largest |rho_f| (ties: lower feature id)
features.null: 20 alive features per layer, not candidates, drawn at random (rng(NULL_SEED + layer)) without replacement, [7, 7, 6] from the 50 alive features nearest to each candidate in log10(mean a_f over selection HSCs) (= mean edit size per gene position)

edit: hooks_v2.Steer(layer, f, alpha, mode='scale', positions=gene positions): delta = (alpha - 1) z_f(x) W_dec[:, f] at every gene position (alpha 0 removes the feature; alpha 1 adds nothing)
positive_control: hooks_v2.AddVector(layer, v, positions=gene positions) with v = mean gene-position residual at the site over selection erythrocytes minus over selection HSCs; two sizes: full v, and v rescaled to the mean alpha = 5 edit size of the 3 candidates (4 x mean over candidates of mean a_f over selection HSCs)

statistics.ci: per-cell percentile bootstrap of the mean over the 50 steered cells, 10000 resamples, seed 20261003 (same resamples for every unit)
statistics.empirical_p: per candidate and alpha: directional p = (1 + #null features with predicted-sign delta_s >= the candidate's) / (1 + 20); size p uses |delta_s|; the smallest possible p is 1/21 = 0.048
statistics.layer_test: 3 candidates vs all C(23,3) = 1,771 subsets of the 23 features (directional stat uses each feature's own sign of rho)
statistics.pooled: Spearman(rho_f, delta_s_f) over 23 features per layer and over all 115; stratified permutation (labels permuted within layer, 100,000 draws) for the sum over layers of the candidates' mean directional rank
